findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/owner-session-token-store.ts:41-65,119-132 and packages/main/src/handlers/doctor.ts:279-286,490-494 — HIGH: generated-token storage has no lifecycle cleanup or doctor inspection/repair, despite the ratified contract R3 requiring storage ownership, cleanup, and doctor visibility. The writer publishes directly to the final path with flag wx; a partial/corrupt final file is treated as unreadable, then every retry gets EEXIST and rethrows forever. Repro on current dist: create one token, replace its JSON with {partial, then call readOrCreateOwnerSessionToken for the same dimensions => ERROR_CODE=EEXIST. This can permanently brick a supported generated-token boundary until an undocumented manual deletion, and tokens otherwise accumulate without expiry/owner-scoped cleanup.
